card.name: Linking words in trial result comparisons
card.fires_on: Small linking words, prepositions or hyphen endings in clinical-trial or animal-study results, right before a group, time span or rate is given (e.g. 'from baseline', 'to mating', 'among the ... groups').

modes.label: Time or change links
modes.description: Prepositions that mark a start or end point or a change over time in study results.
modes.example: were dosed from 5 days prior<< to>> mating to Day 6 of gestation

modes.label: Group comparison links
modes.description: Words linking compared patient groups or treatments, including '-treated' after a drug name.
modes.example: in the daptomycin<<-treated>> adult patients were lower in patients with baseline

card.writes: It seems to push toward statistics and group-comparison wording, and away from general words like progress or research.
